datasets.description: This dataset contains the most up to date version of GLW 4 for the reference year 2020 for the following species: buffalo, cattle, sheep, goats, pigs and chicken,at the resolution of 0.05 ×0.05 , The fourth version of GLW, compared to the previous ones, reflects the most recently compiled and harmonized subnational livestock distribution data. lineage.description: GLW 4 integrates the most recently compiled and harmonized subnational livestock distribution data for six species (buffalo, cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, chicken) to produce gridded livestock density estimates at 0.05×0.05 degree resolution for Ethiopia in reference year 2020, serving as a spatial inventory of agricultural assets for disaster risk assessment.
